mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear night at Harriet Park, and we have a First Quarter moon. Keep your eyes on the skies at 5:42 AM, as the ISS will be visible for four minutes, rising over Mount Horeb and heading toward Madison near Home Depot, reaching high in our sky.

The Verona Police Department recently arrested a school bus driver for O W I after reports of dangerous driving. No injuries were reported, and the city is continuing its look into the matter. Meanwhile, the city is encouraging residents to use the interactive map on the city website to find their specific zoning district and polling locations.

There is plenty happening in our community. Yoga at Insight Wellness is scheduled for today. Looking into tomorrow, you can catch Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia. Later this week, look out for live music at Paddy Mac's and Bailey's Run, plus Thursday night fun at the ART House.

On Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I. Officers responded to reports of dangerous driving and confirmed the driver was impaired, though alcohol was not a factor.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Caramel Peanut Buttercup. Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight.
